assets.service: barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - work clearance records incomplete for HX-4120

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on HX-4120 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 28 February 2007 a planned spot check of HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels not effective.
